## Description

Rewrite ADR-005's mechanism for Postgres: every clinic table has `tenant_id`, `ALTER TABLE ... FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY` with policies reading `current_setting('medvya.tenant_id', true)`, set per connection through the existing interceptor with `set_config(..., false)` reset on return to the pool, and the facility-picker `user_id` branch kept. Replace `infra/sql/roles.sql` with an idempotent Postgres roles script (migrator, app, one role per module, jobs, audit, reporting) with no BYPASSRLS and no superuser for the app. Keep EF global query filters as layer one.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a cross-tenant read or write, when the EF filter is bypassed, then row-level security still blocks it (test fails when the policy is removed).
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the app role, when it connects, then it has no DDL, no BYPASSRLS and only its module schema.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a pooled connection, when it is reused for another tenant, then the tenant setting is reset first.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given the facility picker, when it runs with only a user id, then it sees that user's memberships and nothing else.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
